full_name: Amy J. Cohen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Amy J. Cohen is a professor of law at the Ohio State University, where she is also an affiliated faculty member at the Mershon Center for International Security Studies and the Food Innovation Center. She studies formal and informal dispute resolution, competing ideologies of law and international development, and the political economy of food.
